scientific_integrity: The prime-divisibility test and periodic triangular layers are credited to prior literature; the new claim is the explicit global count and box dimension. All presented computations are finite, while the proof is unrestricted.
scientific_limitations: Primes 2 and 3 excluded; exact counts only on prime-power index windows. No claim for Hausdorff dimension or finer arbitrary-cutoff asymptotics. An unlocated historical equivalent cannot be excluded.
title: Exact prime-coprime index counts for alternating sign matrix numbers
